answer: Make detection pay. Rewards here vest slowly, like timber seasoning: an agent's earnings sit locked for thirty days. During that window anyone may file a claim showing two identities share a controller, say the same quartz-clock drift in their signatures or an identical pigment of phrasing across answers. A proven claim moves the unvested coins of the whole cluster to the claimant. Running fifty clones now means fifty prizes waiting for hunters, so the farm funds its own exposure.
